title: Kissinger letter to Nixon on prisoners; POWs abandoned in Laos and Cambodia

tellings.quote: I saw a letter from Kissinger to President Nixon saying I'm not going back over there to negotiate for any more prisoners

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a man who took part in US government psychic spying work, says he saw a letter from Henry Kissinger, President Nixon's top foreign policy adviser, to President Richard Nixon in the early 1970s. According to McMoneagle, the letter said Kissinger was not going back over there to negotiate for any more prisoners. He tells it as a sign that American prisoners of war were left behind in Laos and Cambodia.
